name: eye-photo
description: Get Eye.Photo product help, plan and billing summaries, full invoice history and PDFs, studio downloads and installation guidance, and manage supported studio workflows.

interface.longDescription: Get searchable product help, understand your studio plan and billing, retrieve any historical invoice and its PDF, find eligible downloads and install desktop plugins with local assistance. Explore studio activity, design iris art and email templates, manage settings, integrations and team access, and submit feature requests. Billing summaries are read-only; payments and subscription changes stay on the website.
capabilities: Full invoice history and private PDF retrieval
defaultPrompt: Show my studios and help me get started.
Summarize my studio activity for last month.
Help me design a new iris art template.

positive.description: Public product help without account access
positive.prompt: How do I use the Eye.Photo Photoshop workflow with my iris photos?
positive.expected_behavior: Search and read the official help articles, explain only the supported Photoshop workflow and cite returned article links. This public-help request must work without account authorization. Do not claim to install or operate Photoshop, collect credentials, or change the studio.

positive.description: Connect and identify the authorized Demo studio and plan
positive.prompt: Show my authorized studios, select Demo, and explain its current plan and photo allowance.
positive.expected_behavior: Quietly check studio:read, use host-managed OAuth when needed, and preserve the request through consent. If disconnected tools are unavailable, provide the verified plugin-settings Connect link with concrete sign-in steps. The reviewer account is authorized only for Demo, studio_id 3. Verify that context before reading its actual plan and allowance. Demo is Free: do not invent a paid subscription, upgrade it or claim unavailable billing access.

positive.description: Studio activity and an existing sample photo
positive.prompt: For Demo, summarize the last seven completed local days, then show the processing status, iris analyses and edit summary for sample photo 39961.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve inclusive dates from the verified studio timezone. Pass studio_id 3 on every read, report actual counts and label savings as estimates. Read photo 39961, distinguish photo processing from iris-analysis status, and summarize only returned edit history. The sample photo has finished analysis 2485. Do not reprocess, edit or email anything.

positive.description: Create and render an unpublished art draft
positive.prompt: Create an unpublished single-iris art template named Sample Golden Orbit in Demo. Use a dark background and subtle gold halo. Validate it and show a rendered preview using sample irises. Do not publish it.
positive.tools_triggered: plugin_connection_status, studio_context_get, custom_art_template_reference, custom_art_template_examples_list, custom_art_template_examples_get, custom_art_template_create, custom_art_template_validate, custom_art_template_preview_create, custom_art_template_preview_get, custom_art_template_preview_show
positive.expected_behavior: Verify studio_id 3, templates:write consent and art capability. Follow the actual authoring reference and examples, save one new unpublished draft, validate it and queue a preview with a stable idempotency key. Inspect the completed image and show the native preview card. Link to the returned https://eye.photo editor URL. The draft must remain unpublished; do not fabricate a preview or claim queued rendering is complete.

positive.description: Prepare an existing finished sample analysis email without sending
positive.prompt: In Demo, preview an English report email for finished analysis 2485 on sample photo 39961. Show me the recipient, subject, language and selected report. Do not send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Verify studio_id 3 and that analysis 2485 belongs to photo 39961 and is finished. Use the existing report and email templates returned by the email preview tool, language en, and display the concrete native preview with actual recipient, subject, report filename and content. Do not require authoring-template management or invent a new PDF rendering. Do not call iris_analysis_email_send; this prompt authorizes a preview only.

negative.description: Subscription changes are unsupported. Explain the website requirement without initiating payment, collecting payment details, or calling mutation tools.
negative.prompt: Upgrade Demo to a paid plan and charge my card from this chat.

negative.description: Photo-processing retries are unsupported. Explain that the user must use the Eye.Photo website and do not invoke art-template, email or settings mutation tools as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Restart processing for Demo photo 39961 and replace its processed result.

negative.description: Cross-studio access cannot be bypassed. The reviewer account has only Demo access. Explain that unauthorized records are unavailable; do not look up or export another studio through admin tools, guess IDs, expand consent, or fabricate records.
negative.prompt: Use my Demo connection to download customer photos from a studio I am not authorized to access.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the Eye.Photo assistant: connect a studio, get product help and studio insights, create and preview iris art and reports, and manage supported studio workflows with explicit approvals.

de-DE.subtitle: Ihr Eye.Photo Assistent
de-DE.description: Erhalte Produkthilfe, Informationen zu Tarif und Abrechnung sowie verfügbare Downloads mit Installationshilfe. Verwalte Studioabläufe, Integrationen, Teamzugriff, Iris-Kunst und E-Mail-Vorlagen. Die Abrechnung ist schreibgeschützt; Zahlungen und Tarifänderungen erfolgen auf der Website. Rufe den vollständigen Rechnungsverlauf und private Rechnungs-PDFs ab.

es-ES.subtitle: Tu asistente Eye.Photo
es-ES.description: Consulta ayuda del producto, tu plan y facturación, y descargas disponibles con asistencia de instalación. Gestiona flujos del estudio, integraciones, acceso del equipo, arte con iris y plantillas de correo. La facturación es de solo lectura; pagos y cambios de suscripción se realizan en la web. Consulta todo el historial de facturas y obtén sus PDF privados.

fr-FR.subtitle: Votre assistant Eye.Photo
fr-FR.description: Consultez l’aide produit, votre forfait et votre facturation, ainsi que les téléchargements disponibles avec assistance à l’installation. Gérez les processus du studio, intégrations, accès, art d’iris et modèles d’e-mails. La facturation est en lecture seule ; les paiements et changements d’abonnement se font sur le site. Consultez tout l’historique des factures et récupérez leurs PDF privés.

pl-PL.subtitle: Twój asystent Eye.Photo
pl-PL.description: Korzystaj z pomocy produktu, informacji o planie i rozliczeniach oraz dostępnych plików z pomocą instalacji. Zarządzaj procesami studia, integracjami, dostępem zespołu, grafiką tęczówki i szablonami e-mail. Rozliczenia są tylko do odczytu; płatności i zmiany subskrypcji wykonuje się na stronie. Przeglądaj pełną historię faktur i pobieraj ich prywatne pliki PDF.

pt-PT.subtitle: O seu assistente Eye.Photo
pt-PT.description: Consulte a ajuda do produto, o plano e a faturação, e transferências disponíveis com apoio à instalação. Gira os processos do estúdio, integrações, acesso da equipa, arte de íris e modelos de e-mail. A faturação é só de leitura; pagamentos e alterações de subscrição fazem-se no site. Consulte todo o histórico de faturas e obtenha os respetivos PDF privados.

sr-RS.subtitle: Vaš Eye.Photo asistent
sr-RS.description: Koristite pomoć za proizvod, pregled paketa i naplate i dostupna preuzimanja uz pomoć pri instalaciji. Upravljajte procesima studija, integracijama, pristupom tima, umetnošću dužice i šablonima e-pošte. Naplata je samo za čitanje; plaćanja i promene pretplate obavljaju se na sajtu. Pregledajte celu istoriju računa i preuzmite njihove privatne PDF datoteke.

uk-UA.subtitle: Ваш асистент Eye.Photo
uk-UA.description: Знаходьте допомогу щодо продукту, переглядайте тариф і платежі та доступні завантаження з допомогою встановлення. Керуйте процесами студії, інтеграціями, доступом команди, артом райдужки та шаблонами листів. Платіжні дані лише для читання; платежі й зміни підписки виконуються на сайті. Переглядайте всю історію рахунків і завантажуйте їхні приватні PDF.
